title: The Gone Manuscript
scene: At 10:40 AM, the archive manuscript disappeared. The reading lift was stuck from 10:25 to 10:55.

suspects.name: Yara Voss
suspects.testimony: I was in the lift at 10:40, trapped between floors.
suspects.contradiction: The lift was empty when rescue opened it, and the manuscript was under Yara's coat.

suspects.name: Zane Cole
suspects.testimony: I was at the archive door at 10:40.
suspects.alibiProof: The door camera shows Zane at 10:38 and 10:46.

suspects.name: Bella Reed
suspects.testimony: I was at the microfilm desk at 10:40.
suspects.alibiProof: The microfilm log shows Bella's request at 10:36.

suspects.name: Cyrus Hale
suspects.testimony: I was shelving boxes in the back at 10:40.
suspects.alibiProof: The shelf camera shows Cyrus at 10:39 and 10:45.
